headword: {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}
gloss: open year-round; no holidays; 365 days a year

definitions.gloss: open year-round; no holidays; 365 days a year
definitions.explanation: Describes a business or facility that operates every day of the year without regular closing days. Very commonly seen on signs at shops, restaurants, and convenience stores.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}です。
{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}で{営業|えいぎょう}しています。
examples.english: We are open every day of the year.

examples.japanese: コンビニは{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}で24{時間|じかん}{営業|えいぎょう}しているので、{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Convenience stores are open year-round, 24 hours a day, so they're convenient.

notes:
A four-character compound meaning literally 'year-through no-rest': {年中|ねんじゅう} (throughout the year) + {無休|むきゅう} (no holidays/rest). Extremely common on shop signs and business information in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}で{営業|えいぎょう}: open for business year-round
- {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}・24{時間|じかん}{営業|えいぎょう}: open 365 days, 24 hours

RELATED TERMS:
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}: regular closing day — the opposite concept
- {無休|むきゅう}: no holidays/days off
- {年中|ねんじゅう}: throughout the year; all year long

CULTURAL NOTE:
This phrase is ubiquitous in Japan, where many convenience stores, family restaurants, and chain businesses operate every day of the year. It is often displayed prominently on storefronts.
